Name: Cuter Witchy Valley Potions
Author: GioWoma
Description:
[center]ENG: Just a small mod which changes how the [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/7312?tab=description]Witchy Valley[/url]﻿ potions look to make them look prettier¡
Inspired in [url=https://next.nexusmods.com/profile/dollynhoevida/about-me?gameId=1303&_gl=1*10od8ze*_ga*MjAwMTkyNTQ0NS4xNzEwMzcyNzQz*_ga_N0TELNQ37M*MTcxNDk2MDkzOS43LjEuMTcxNDk2MTgyOC4wLjAuMA..]dollynhoevida[/url]﻿﻿ [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/19315]"Cuter Potions"[/url] mod.﻿

ESP: ¡Solo un pequeño mod que cambia la apariencia de las pociones de Witchy Valley para hacerlas más bonitas![/center][center]Inspirado en el mod de [url=https://next.nexusmods.com/profile/dollynhoevida/about-me?gameId=1303&_gl=1*10od8ze*_ga*MjAwMTkyNTQ0NS4xNzEwMzcyNzQz*_ga_N0TELNQ37M*MTcxNDk2MDkzOS43LjEuMTcxNDk2MTgyOC4wLjAuMA..]dollynhoevida[/url]﻿﻿: [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/19315]"Cuter Potions"[/url].[/center]
[b][size=5][center][color=#d5a6bd]☆ INSTALLATION - ENGLISH ☆[/color]﻿[/center][/size][/b]
[list=1]
[*]Download and unzip the RAR file.
[*]Go to the mods folder and the [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/7312?tab=description]Witchy Valley[/url]﻿ folder
[*]Enter the folder "[JA] Witchy Valley SVE"
[*]Replace the "object" folder with the one you got from the rar file.
[/list]
[center][size=5][b]☆ INSTALACION - ESPAÑOL ☆[/b][/size][/center]
[list=1]
[*]Descargar y descomprimir el archivo RAR.
[*]Ir a la carpeta de mods y a la carpeta de [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/7312?tab=description]Witchy Valley[/url]﻿
[*]Entrar en la carpeta "[JA] Witchy Valley SVE"
[*]Reemplazar la carpeta "object" con la carpeta conseguida de el archivo rar.
[/list]
